description: The plot illustrates mean interclass (cosine) similarity values across relation categories for three generation/training settings, with additional horizontal reference lines showing the average similarity for each setting. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category” on a linear scale, spanning integer categories from 0 to about 65 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. The y-axis is labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, and 0.5. Three solid lines with small point markers are shown: the blue solid line (“w/o DPO obo”) fluctuates across categories, starting near 0.22 at category 0, showing an early peak close to 0.48 around category 1, and ending near 0.03 at the final category; a blue dotted horizontal line marks its average at 0.107 (also annotated as “0.107” near the left). The orange solid line (“w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) varies with several prominent spikes, beginning near 0.16 at category 0, rising to around 0.38 near the mid-left portion (around category ~16), reaching a high close to 0.46 around category ~31 (with another high around ~33 near 0.43), and finishing near 0.07 at the final category; its orange dotted average line is at 0.158 (annotated “0.158”). The green solid line (“DPO”) stays within a narrower band most of the time, starting around 0.18 at category 0, dipping to low values near ~0.03 in the early categories, showing moderate local rises up to roughly 0.18–0.20 in the middle categories, and ending near 0.08 at the final category; its green dotted average line is at 0.086 (annotated “0.086”).
